description: Prompt refiner: before Claude works on a prompt, restate it as a brief, ask about open points, and delegate the brief instead of the raw prompt

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/refiner.py" hook prompt; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit $rc;; esac; done; exit 0
